name: Retribution For Bills
source:
The story follows Adrian Shields, a police detective of about forty years of age who has spent almost half of his life working. What's it like to work as a cop in Detroit when there's a catastrophic shortage of manpower, the labs are woefully under-equipped, the equipment is obsolete, and the city has zero cameras that can easily help you find a criminal and point out where he's hiding? Well, it's a hell of a job, but he did the best he could. 

The main case in his career would be the investigation of a series of murders commited by a man nicknamed the "Heartbreaker".

Since 1993, the Heartbreaker has brutally murdered children between the ages of four and seven every couple of months. To begin with, he slit the throat of a child who was still alive and then cut his heart out of his chest. Despite the brazen nature of some of the murders (i.e, children being abducted straight from their homes while family members were present) no one has actually seen the Heartbreaker. Moreover, he is extremely cautious and cunning. 

Up until the beginning of the plot, the police have no fingerprints or DNA of the perpetrator. Adrian has been working for several years as part of a task force that deals exclusively with the case of the Heartbreaker. Then finally there is a chance for justice to nail the perpetrator...

[translated, modified from [url=https://orbllits.itch.io/retribution-for-bills]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了阿德里安·希尔兹 (Adrian Shields) 的故事，他是一位四十岁左右的警探，一生中几乎一半的时间都在工作。当底特律人手严重短缺、实验室设备严重不足、设备陈旧、城市里的零个摄像头可以轻松帮助你找到罪犯并指出他的藏身之处时，在底特律工作是什么感觉？嗯，这是一项糟糕的工作，但他已经尽力了。

他职业生涯中的主要案件是调查一名绰号为“伤心人”的男子犯下的一系列谋杀案。

自1993年以来，“伤心者”每隔几个月就会残忍地杀害4至7岁的儿童。首先，他割断了一个还活着的孩子的喉咙，然后从胸口切出了他的心脏。尽管有些谋杀案性质十分明目张胆（即儿童在家人在场的情况下被直接从家中绑架），但没有人真正见过《伤心者》。而且，他还极其的谨慎和狡猾。

直到剧情开始，警方还没有找到肇事者的指纹或DNA。阿德里安多年来一直在专门处理“伤心者”案件的特别工作组中工作。然后终于有机会将肇事者绳之以法……

[翻译，修改自 [url=https://orbllits.itch.io/retribution-for-bills]Itch.io[/url]]
